第30章 突出！突出！再突出！-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

于蓝是个副主任，但赵绍义谈起于蓝，脸上表情比主任马德波更恭敬。
这是因为于蓝是北影厂第一任厂长田方的遗孀，也就是田壮壮的母亲。
马德波从73年担任编导办公室主任，还主管北影厂的电影剧本杂志《电影创作》，是主管剧本和创作策划的领导。
王陶瑞是文学部的剧本组组长，并且发展潜力很足，是北影厂重点培养的文学部编辑。
下午两点，赵绍义轻轻敲响刘济民的房门。刘济民利落地穿上衣服，走到门口时，将脸扎进水盆，好好清醒了一下。
出门看到隔壁的朱新运正在搬宿舍，他的另外三个室友，看到刘济民后，都忙转身假装忙碌。
朱新运看了刘济民一眼后，目光躲闪，低头不语。
“好了，以后啊别闹腾，招待所是睡觉的地方，不是练功的地方，要唱去话剧团的舞台上练。”赵绍义忍不住安慰了几句。
刘济民笑了笑，没有说话。有时候，痛到身上才能长记性。
走出招待所，火辣辣的太阳晒得刘济民脊梁疼，他不自觉地加快了前往主楼的脚步。
走进会议室，看到了梁晓生正忙着给茶缸里倒水，此时还没有人过来。
“小梁，你通知一下大家，就说济民同志到了。”赵绍义说道。
“行。”
赵绍义给刘济民指了指位置：“济民，你坐这儿。”
约莫十分钟，一个穿着白短袖衬衫的中年妇女率先走了进来，灰色的长裤和白衬衫，显得整个人十分干练。
她的目光扫视一圈，看到刘济民后，笑着问道：“老赵，这就是济民同志吧？”
“于主任？”刘济民试探着说道。
“于大姐，我给你介绍下，这是济民同志。”赵绍义起身笑着说道，“济民啊，这就是于蓝主任，你们以前认识？”
“不认识，我看您觉得熟悉。您在《烈火中永生》里面饰演‘江姐’，这电影我看过好几遍，演的太好了，眼神让人拍案叫绝。”
“哈哈哈，跟以前比起来老了。十几年前的电影，难为你们这些年轻人还记得。”于蓝望着刘济民的眼神，显得更满意了。

Yu Lan is a deputy director, but when Zhao Shaoyi talks about Yu Lan, his expression is more respectful than that of director Ma Debo.
This is because Yu Lan is the widow of Tian Fang, the first director of Beijing Film Studio, and the mother of Tian Zhuangzhuang.
Ma Debo has been the director of the director's office since 1973. He is also in charge of Beijing Film Studio's film script magazine "Film Creation" and is the leader in charge of scripts and creative planning.
Wang Taorui is the script team leader of the Literature Department, and has great potential for development. He is the editor of the Literature Department that Beijing Film Studio focuses on training.
At two o'clock in the afternoon, Zhao Shaoyi knocked gently on Liu Jimin's door. Liu Jimin put on his clothes neatly, and when he walked to the door, he plunged his face into the basin and sobered up.
When I went out, I saw Zhu Xinyun moving into the dormitory next door. His other three roommates, when they saw Liu Jimin, they all turned around and pretended to be busy.
After Zhu Xinyun glanced at Liu Jimin, his eyes averted and he lowered his head and said nothing.
"Okay, don't make any noise in the future. The guest house is a place to sleep, not a place to practice. You have to sing and practice on the stage of the drama troupe." Zhao Shaoyi couldn't help but comfort him a few words.
Liu Jimin smiled and said nothing. Sometimes, it takes pain to remember something.
When he walked out of the guest house, the scorching sun made Liu Jimin's spine hurt, and he unconsciously speeded up his steps to the main building.
When I walked into the conference room, I saw Liang Xiaosheng busy pouring water into the tea vat. No one had come yet.
"Xiao Liang, please inform everyone that Comrade Jimin has arrived." Zhao Shaoyi said.
"Okay."
Zhao Shaoyi pointed to Liu Jimin's position: "Jimin, sit here."
About ten minutes later, a middle-aged woman wearing a white short-sleeved shirt walked in first. She looked very capable in gray trousers and a white shirt.
She glanced around, and when she saw Liu Jimin, she asked with a smile: "Old Zhao, is this Comrade Jimin?"
"Director Yu?" Liu Jimin asked tentatively.
"Sister Yu, let me introduce to you, this is Comrade Jimin." Zhao Shaoyi stood up and said with a smile, "Jimin, this is Director Yu Lan, have you known each other before?"
"I don't know you, but I think you feel familiar. You played the role of 'Sister Jiang' in "Eternal Life in Fire". I have watched this movie several times. You acted so well, and your eyes are amazing."
"Hahaha, I'm older than before. It's hard for young people like you to remember the movies from more than ten years ago." Yu Lan looked at Liu Jimin, looking even more satisfied.
